attributes.context: The surrounding paragraph in the POWER GENERATION attachment sets a normal Welder A test schedule, with a first test within six months after attaining MJ/MMJ Welder status and a second test one year after a first failure.

extraction_text: Semi-automatic progression of the Welder in MJ or MMJ classification is contingent on passing the Welder A Test and meeting other MMJ or MJ qualifications.

attributes.context: The surrounding paragraph sets a normal Welder B test schedule for MJ/MMJ apprentice classifications, including first tests within three months after starting Segment 5, second tests within three to six months after a first failure, and corresponding timing for a secondary Welder designator.

extraction_text: Semi-automatic progression in the MJ and MMJ Apprentice classifications is contingent on passing the Welder B test and meeting other MJ or MMJ Apprentice qualifications.
